description: A specifier that only the tree's own manifests can explain. `@acme/store/queries/run` is neither a relative path nor a tsconfig alias: it is the NAME `packages/store` publishes itself under, and npm/pnpm/yarn make it resolve by symlinking that directory into `node_modules`. A source checkout has none, so every cross-package call lowered as external and interprocedural dataflow stopped dead at every package boundary -- measured on documenso, 5,646 calls carrying a `@documenso/` symbol, all external, which is the layout of every workspace monorepo rather than one project's quirk. The five positives each cross the boundary by a different mechanism, taken shape for shape from the corpus: a bare package name answered by `main` (documenso); a SUBPATH under a package that declares no `exports`, which is how documenso writes all 5,646; a package whose `exports`, `types`, `module` and `main` all name an unbuilt `dist/` and whose `src/index.ts` is therefore the only followable file left (medplum); an `exports` key whose target is not where any convention would look; and that map's wildcard pattern (reactive-resume). The negatives are what keeps the mapping honest, because a wrong edge fabricates a flow the program never makes. Two packages here publish `@acme/twins`, and nothing in the tree says which one `sweep` meant -- so it resolves to NOTHING and neither shell behind it is reported, rather than the resolver picking whichever manifest it read first. `@acme/absent` is declared by no manifest at all and stays external for the same reason: a workspace mapping states what the tree's OWN names mean, and a resolver that guesses past it invents callees.

expected.note: the bare package name `@acme/store`, answered by the manifest's `main`
a subpath with no `exports` map: relative to the package's own directory, which is documenso's shape
every declared entry names an unbuilt `dist/`; the package's own `src/index.ts` is the only followable file, which is medplum's shape
an `exports` key whose target no convention would find
an `exports` wildcard pattern, which is reactive-resume's shape
